decisionQuestion: Did a cheaper official embedding SKU appear while ada-002 stayed listed?

before.quote: from a price per 1k tokens of $0.0001 to $0.00002. We are not deprecating text-embedding-ada-002
before.extraction: Same official post. Before-row is the still-sold ada-002 list price $0.0001 / 1k tokens, which the post states as the previous-generation price and says is not deprecated.

after.quote: Pricing for text-embedding-3-small has therefore been reduced by 5X compared to text-embedding-ada-002, from a price per 1k tokens of $0.0001 to $0.00002.
after.extraction: After-rows keep ada-002 at $0.0001 and add text-embedding-3-small at the explicit $0.00002 / 1k tokens. These are two SKUs, not a rename of one field. text-embedding-3-large at $0.00013 / 1k tokens is omitted here to keep the pair to one added SKU.

limits: Do not treat ada-002 and 3-small as the same field.
5X is the post's comparison across SKUs, not an ada-002 price cut.
Released vendor-budget-impact currently reports added=1 but action no-budget-delta.
